SELECT f.id, f.bill_no, f.node_no, f.round_no, f.status, f.done_at, f.del_flag, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, f.remark, COALESCE(s.cur_sign_count, 0) AS cur_sign_count, COUNT(*) OVER() AS board_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_veh_xfer_bill WHERE del_flag = 0 AND (status IS NULL OR status = 0)) AS board_active_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_veh_xfer_bill WHERE del_flag = 0 AND (status IS NULL OR status = 0) AND node_no = 0) AS board_node0_active, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_veh_xfer_bill WHERE del_flag = 0 AND (status IS NULL OR status = 0) AND node_no = 1) AS board_node1_active, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_veh_xfer_bill WHERE del_flag = 0 AND (status IS NULL OR status = 0) AND node_no = 2) AS board_node2_active FROM t_veh_xfer_bill f
LEFT JOIN (SELECT bill_id, node_no, round_no, COUNT(*) AS cur_sign_count FROM t_veh_xfer_sign WHERE del_flag = 0 GROUP BY bill_id, node_no, round_no) s ON s.bill_id = f.id AND s.node_no = f.node_no AND s.round_no = f.round_no
f.del_flag = 0
AND f.bill_no LIKE CONCAT(#{billNo}, '%')
AND f.status = #{status}
AND f.node_no = #{nodeNo}
ORDER BY f.id DESC
